d: In this video, Firstpost explains the Trump administration's plan to deport more than 150 Afghan immigrants detained in Louisiana. The group reportedly includes relatives of Afghans who assisted US forces and individuals who could face persecution under Taliban rule. The administration plans to send them to Pakistan, which will oversee their transfer across the border into Afghanistan. The route could help Washington bypass diplomatic and legal hurdles that have prevented direct deportations.
